content.summary: Organize related details into one collapsible group at a time.
Content with its image's colors glowing softly behind it, the way Apple lets a photo light its surroundings.
A responsive crop frame that preserves the image's proportions.
Show the current page within a hierarchy of linked ancestors.
A native button with six variants and eight sizes. State is plain CSS, so it has no machine and costs about 1 KB.
A small label for status, sharing or categories, quiet enough to sit beside any text.
Code with selectable source and optional line numbers.
A searchable Picker with the same control, glass surface and keyboard behavior. Optionally offer creation from a new query.
A compact command palette for finding destinations and performing quick actions.
A date shown as a compact button that opens a month calendar, like the compact DatePicker on iPhone.
A time shown as a compact button that opens columns of hours and minutes, on the clock people read where they live.
A clear empty state with context and a useful next action.
A raised card with parts for its heading, rows, dividers and large figures.
Actions for one thing, opened by right-clicking on a computer or pressing and holding on a touch screen.
A thread of messages like Messages on iPhone, and a reply field with a round Send button.
Day, month and year fields for dates people already know, like a birthday, in the order their locale writes them.
A focused question or short form over the page, on the Zag dialog machine, with enter and exit transitions that reverse mid flight.
A labelled expandable row with a smooth, in-place reveal for settings and details.
A quiet line that separates related rows, groups, or adjacent actions.
A round button that shows only an icon, for toolbars, players and tight rows.
A spring-driven inline reveal for account settings and small details.
A compact keycap for application keyboard commands.
A settings row: a label and description, with a control or value at the trailing edge.
A small floating language button that opens into a list of languages, each in its own name, and can be dragged to any corner.
A button that opens an anchored set of commands or choices using PassUI's native menu host.
One native input drawn as code cells, with paste, autofill and verification feedback.
A pop-up button that shows the current choice and opens a menu of options, never a native select.
A small floating panel beside its trigger, on the Zag popover machine. It flips to stay on screen and grows from its trigger side.
A round photo of a person that falls back to their initials while it loads or if it fails.
Show how much of an operation has completed, or that an operation is still in progress.
Compare a small set of mutually exclusive choices.
A compact search input with a magnifying glass, for filtering lists as people type.
A search field with a list of results that filters as you type and can be driven with the arrow keys.
A titled, inset group of rows with a footer note, as in iOS Settings.
A password field with an optional Show and Hide button.
A row of two to five options where exactly one is chosen, that turns into a Picker when it runs out of room.
A panel that slides in from any edge and swipes away, on the Zag drawer machine with the iOS sheet curve over 500 ms.
Titled groups of navigation rows for a sidebar, with an icon, a label and an optional count on each row.
Reserve space while content is loading, with optional spoken status.
Adjust a number across a continuous range with native keyboard, pointer, and touch interactions.
A rigid handle with a spring-following liquid fill and a subtle meniscus.
A number with a label and a quiet caption, for dashboards and summaries.
A small dot and text that say whether something is saved, syncing or offline.
Increase or decrease a controlled numeric value in exact, bounded increments.
A row of colour swatches with names, for choosing one colour.
The app's main places in a floating glass capsule at the bottom of the screen, as iOS 26 draws it, with an optional Search button.
Styled parts for a plain HTML table: header, rows, cells, a footer and a caption, scrolling sideways when it's wider than the screen.
A row of tabs that switches between panels of content on the same screen.
A multi-line text area that matches the look of Passui's text fields and grows when dragged.
A labelled single line input with room for a hint and error messages.
A short message that drops from the top like an island to confirm, show progress or explain a failure, then leaves on its own.
An on and off control: a switch for settings that apply at once, or a checkbox for choices you confirm later.
A short label on hover or keyboard focus, on the Zag tooltip machine. It never opens on touch and its neighbours skip the delay.
The frame of one screen: a large title with an optional description and action, then the screen's content.
A compact seeker whose marks briefly rise along the path of a fast drag.
An interruption that needs an answer, such as confirming a deletion. An outside press does nothing and focus lands on Cancel.
A bottom sheet with a grab handle that you drag down to dismiss, on the Zag drawer machine. Resting heights come from snap points.
A list of actions from a button, on the Zag menu machine, with checkbox and radio items, groups, shortcuts and submenus.
